ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Dec-30-2003 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for OSC hearing for Change of Name and Gender.
Commissioner Sue Kaplan, Clerks: S. Ravinantapricha/V.Mack, CSR: Deborah Neville

Petitioner Marcus Grannis Selby present in pro per, was sworn and examined.

The Court grants the petition for change of name to: Marla Genevieve Selby

The Court further orders the GENDER of Marla Genevieve Selby is changed from MALE to FEMALE

Decree signed in open court.
